A MacBook-style notch for Windows that shows what GitHub Copilot has cost you **today**, in US dollars. It updates live, with a per-model breakdown and month-to-date spend.

## Install

1. Download **{{file}}** below and run it.
2. The installer isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. The notch appears at the top center of your screen. Hover to expand it, and right-click the tray icon for options.

It requires Windows 10 or 11 and the GitHub Copilot app or Copilot CLI. Spend Notch reads their local session store (`%USERPROFILE%\.copilot\session-store.db`) in read-only mode.
